QuestInfo.name: After School Special Training
QuestInfo.0: After you reach Level 30, the headmaster strikes up a conversation with you.
QuestInfo.1: The Headmaster tells you that you need to take the #bAfter School Special Training#k. You should go to class and meet your teacher. Special Training, Class, and Teacher are the Resistance passwords! Go to the #bResistance Underground Base#k and meet #b#p2151001##k.
QuestInfo.2: You have a new mission as a Resistance member. It's a tough mission, specially assigned to you... You cannot refuse it, nor do you want to.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. You've already reached Level 30, I see. You must be diligently studying and working hard to gain experience. I'm proud of you.
0.1: We are planning to hold an #bafter school Special Training session#k for those who have reached Lv. 30. If you're not too busy, I'd like to invite you...

yes.0: The after-school special training will be run by your homeroom teacher. Please #bhead into the school#k. I have reason to believe your class will be both enjoyable and productive.

no.0: Ah, tired of studying already? But there's still so much for you to learn. Please, think it over. This training can really help you.

1.0: Welcome, student. Finally, after all day sweeping the streets, smiling like a moron, I get to assign a more exciting and difficult task. Looks like I've got something tough lined up for you. Feel free to run off and hide if you don't think you can handle it, ha!

yes.0: Haha. Of course a Battle Mage be eager to fight. Talk to me again for details about the mission.

npc.0: You didn't take the special training session yet? Your homeroom teacher is waiting for you in the classroom. It's where you entered using the #bSpecial Training Invitation#k last time..
npc.1: #b(Special Training, Classroom, Homeroom Teacher... All of these are words used in the Resistance. This must be a Resistance mission! Hurry over to the Underground Base.)#k
